title: Probability of a complement
statement: For any real bias parameter $\rho$, any nonnegative integer $m$, and any predicate $A$ on Boolean strings, the biased probability that $A$ fails on a string of length $m$ is one minus the biased probability of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on Boolean strings
